programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty

programme.title: Rustum

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Apartment

programme.desc: Rick attempts to convert a fish phobic Henry, by catching a sea bass together and grilling it with a vanilla sauce. Plus, he shows a tasty way of cooking plaice. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick cooks up a fish feast for Padstow's May Day celebrations. He makes some red mullet pasta, steamed oysters, cod Portuguese, crabmeat pasties and squid spring rolls. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver shares his secrets for making simple and delicious recipes with just five ingredients, saving time and money but that are big on flavour. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: Goin' Big. Guy and Hunter get inspiration from a Wyoming chef to make a tasty Stromboli. The menu also includes seafood stew and cinnamon rolls. S33, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: Carnivore Delivery. Guy and Hunter serve up recipes including monster beef ribs from Las Vegas, a waffle-hamburger mashup from Atlanta and pizza and wings from San Antonio. S33, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: All Kinds Of Flavor. Guy Fieri cooks takeout with four chefs via video chat. He makes American Indian fare from Denver and short ribs all the way from Hawaii. S33, Ep4

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: South Dakota Smorgasbord. Guy is in South Dakota to visit the state's first Ethiopian joint, And, he checks out the unique comfort food at a Midwest-Southern restaurant. S33, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Spicin' Things Up. In South Dakota, Guy visits a gourmet sandwich joint that's making delicious fusion food. And, he checks out a quirky pizza restaurant in Alaska. S33, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Savoury Meat And A Little Sweet. In North Dakota, Guy visits a bakery café that makes sticky pecan rolls from scratch. And, he stops by a market-butcher eatery in South Dakota. S33, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: Sweet And Savory. A chef from Las Vegas teaches Guy and Hunter how to make his sweet and savoury crepes. Later, they cook up peach cobbler and empanadas. S34, Ep5

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Pasta, Potatoes & Pescatarian. Vanilla Ice takes Guy to his favourite Ecuadorian joint in West Palm Beach, Florida. Plus, Guy is in Minnesota to try scratch-made pasta and poutine. S34, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Pig's Feet, Mojo And Chow-Chow. Guy tastes seafood and chow-chow in Palm Beach, Florida. Later, he visits a funky Filipino joint in Hawaii to sample their spin on pig's feet. S34, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Taste Of The Tropics. Guy tucks into lobster enchiladas and lionfish rolls at a waterside restaurant in Florida. Plus, he chows down on Vietnamese sandwiches and spring rolls. S34, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: Best Of The West. Guy and Hunter Fieri cook up some sizzling takeout with a crazy burger from Phoenix and handmade sausages from Portland, Oregon. S34, Ep2

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: All Over The Menu. Guy and Hunter cook chicken and biscuits from Brooklyn and Jamaican oxtail and wings from Cincinnati. And there's a new kind of crab cake from Baltimore. S34, Ep3

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Takeout: Real Deal Delivery. Guy and Hunter serve up real deal barbecue from Los Angeles, wild Thai dishes out of Phoenix and a monster lasagne from Minneapolis. S34, Ep4

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Beefy Burgers. Adam visits a historic diner in Rhode Island to try a Triple Murder Burger. And, he is challenged to eat the six-pound Big Ugly Burger at a restaurant in Indiana. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Cheesy Goodness. Adam is in Texas to chow down on a 42-inch pizza smothered in mozzarella. And, he is challenged to eat a five-pound grilled cheese sandwich. S1, Ep3

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Juicy Bites. Adam tastes a succulent Italian beef sandwich and a slow-cooked BBQ brisket. Later, he is given 15 minutes to eat his way through a six-layer meat platter. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Fiery Flavors. Adam tries an infamous Triple Habanero Pie and a spicy pulled pork sandwich. Later, he takes on a six-piece spicy tuna roll drenched in a fiery concoction. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Fried Feasts. Adam stops by a restaurant in Florida to try their foot-long, deep-fried beef hot dog. Later, Adam is challenged to eat 28 pieces of fried catfish. S1, Ep7

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Savory Seafood. Adam samples a half-pound filet of fresh hogfish topped with sauteed mushrooms and melted cheese. Plus, Adam is given an hour to eat 180 raw oysters. S1, Ep8

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: BBQ Bliss. Adam is in Tennessee to taste succulent baby back ribs that have been charcoal smoked for 14 hours. And, he is challenged to finish a humongous smoked meat sandwich. S1, Ep9

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Classic Comfort Food. Adam tries a huge cinnamon roll and a Belgian waffle topped with barbecue pulled pork. Plus, he is challenged to eat a giant sandwich and a colossal milkshake. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Sizzlin' Steaks. Adam chows down on an amazing steak sandwich in Lewiston, New York. Later, he takes on a mammoth challenge to eat a total of 74 ounces of steak. S1, Ep11

programme.title: Man V. Food Best Of
programme.desc: Sensational Sausages. Adam tastes some of the most delicious sausage dishes in America. Later, he attempts to eat a six-pound scramble of eggs, sausage, pepperoni, and hash browns. S1, Ep12

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Granada. In Granada James samples giant tapas, visits a restaurant with amazing views, and goes to an organic caviar farm. He cooks steak and Moroccan chicken. S1, Ep15

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Murcia. In Murcia James eats exceptional tapas, is shown how to make Caldero and visits an apricot farm. Plus, he cooks cured tuna, steak and roast lobster. S1, Ep16

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Custard Week. The bakers put their twist on floating islands in the Signature, tackle a summer staple, and make custard the star of a showstopping set gateau. S13, Ep7

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Pastry Week. The bakers tackle vol-au-vents, a delicious savoury snack and a 3D pie-scape depicting their favourite childhood story. S13, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Patisserie Week. It's the semi-final, and the bakers tackle mini charlottes, a vertical technical challenge and a Swedish showstopper. Who will soar into the final? S13, Ep9

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The Final. The remaining bakers make a perfect picnic, a summer classic and a baked celebration of our planet. Who will be crowned the winner? S13, Ep10

programme.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
programme.desc: Costa Blanca. In Costa Blanca James visits a cherry orchard and meets a fisherman selling Denia shrimp. Plus, he cooks pork with cherries and spiced tuna salad. S1, Ep17

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Baltimore. Adam Richman's search for the best grub in the USA takes him to Baltimore, Maryland, for some pit beef, blue crabs, and the Great Steak Challenge. S2, Ep13

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Washington, DC. Adam travels to Washington D.C. for a famed chilli half-smoke, a jumbo fish sandwich, and a giant milkshake-sandwich combo known as the Colossal Challenge! S2, Ep14

programme.title: Michel Roux's French Country Cooking
programme.desc: Michel visits a free-range farm and is inspired to cook a delicious guinea fowl dish. Plus, he reveals his quick and easy croque monsieur recipe. S1, Ep5

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Ten Craft Families of Chanoyu
programme.desc: The Senke Jusshoku are ten legendary craft families that have been making tea ceremony utensils for centuries - we are given unprecedented access to their closely guarded practices for over a year.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: World Heritage Under Threat
programme.desc: The climax to our week-long series on the effects of climate change on World Heritage Sites. We visit iconic sites around the world and also report from the UNESCO Committee Session held in Busan.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Train Cruise
programme.desc: We travel through the mountainous area 100km northwest of Tokyo and cover Tochigi, Gunma and Saitama Prefectures as we focus on timber and meet local residents who appreciate the blessings of nature.

programme.title: Japanology Plus mini
programme.desc: Onigiri is Japan's comfort food - we explore new types trending on social media, the latest convenience store offerings, and an emergency version that can be stored at room temperature for five years.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Design X Stories
programme.desc: Today's theme: Designing for Touch. Information today comes from devices, but creatives in various fields are re-centring the human sensation of touch. Explore the potential of designing for touch.

programme.title: Story Land
programme.desc: Leading actors take turns as solo storytellers to act and recite traditional folk tales loved in Japan for centuries - watch out for some delightful illustrations too!

programme.title: Texico
programme.desc: Learn programming principles without a computer! Animated characters provide fun and lucid explanations of five core processes: analysis, combination, generalisation, abstraction and simulation.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Samurai Castles
programme.desc: A castle 200km north of Tokyo was a battleground in Japan's last civil war in the mid-19th century - modern warfare did not bring it down. We look at the secrets to the its strengths and its lords.

programme.title: Cinematic Journey
programme.desc: Daniel Moore takes a cinematic journey through Nagano - he hits the south in springtime to experience the breathtaking cherry blossoms and gets lost in magical winter landscapes up north.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: Edo's Rush Hour: Edo was a city of waterways; the Yoroi Ferry transported people across the Nihonbashi River, a main commercial artery. A captain's job was high-pressure and required skill and guts.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship hourly news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: Many mountains in Japan that attract tourists are active volcanoes - learn safety tips for climbing and the latest on eruption prediction research.

programme.title: Design Museum Japan
programme.desc: Niigata / Nishizawa Ryue (architect). In a coastal district, boat builders used their skills to make houses. Nishizawa considers how architecture is affected by a community's terrain and values.

programme.desc: Kataoka Ainosuke takes his first turn as our host. Ainosuke is a renowned kabuki actor. He'll be our guide to the attractions of kabuki looking at some of the roles he's played.

programme.desc: Warrington Wolves host Huddersfield Giants in the Betfred Super League. Matt Dufty was the match winner for Warrington previously as his side emerged 24-18 winners at Hull KR. (05.07)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: In a huge game at the top of the table, fourth-placed St Helens host a table-topping Hull KR in the Betfred Super League. Willie Peters' side are now six games undefeated. (24.08)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: Hull KR host rivals Hull FC in round six of the Betfred Super League. The Robins bounced back from consecutive defeats by winning away from home at Huddersfield in round five. (29.03)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: Action from the Betfred Super League, as high-flying Warrington Wolves play host to a Leigh Leopards side with just one win to their name. (20.04)

programme.title: S/Lge: Leigh v Wigan
programme.desc: Both in scintillating form and sat inside the top six, rivals Leigh Leopards and Wigan Warriors meet for the second instalment of the Battle of the Borough.

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: The Brick Community Stadium stages action from the Betfred Women's Super League, as fourth-placed Wigan Warriors take on second-in-the-table Leeds Rhinos. (13.09)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: In the Betfred Super League, Leeds Rhinos clash with Steve McNamara's Catalans Dragons, whose 0-34 victory over London Broncos last week produced four different try-scorers (02.03)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: In the Betfred Super League, Hull FC host Hull KR at the MKM Stadium during round one. This season, Hull FC are looking to emulate the Robins who enjoyed a successful 2023 campaign. (15.02)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: A Grand Final rematch, as Catalans Dragons take on second-placed Wigan in the Betfred Super League. An inconsistent Catalans sit in sixth place with Leigh and Leeds close by. (31.08)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: Unbeaten at home, Catalans Dragons host Warrington Wolves in the Betfred Super League. Third-placed Warrington take back-to-back league wins to the south of France. (25.05)

programme.title: Men's State Of Origin #2 Hlts

programme.title: Men's State Of Origin #3 Hlts
programme.desc: The third and final encounter in the 2026 men's State of Origin series sees the Blues and Maroons in a battle of Australian state pride.

programme.title: Women's State of Origin 2026
programme.desc: One of Australia's great sporting rivalries continues with game two of the 2026 Women's State of Origin Series between the Blues and Maroons at Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane. (14.05)

programme.title: Women's State of Origin 2026
programme.desc: The Women's State of Origin Series reaches its finale as the Maroons and Blues bring proceedings to a close at the Cbus Super Stadium in Queensland. (28.05)

programme.title: Live NRL: Panthers v Canberra
programme.desc: Amid a late-season charge to the finals, the Raiders head to Penrith Panthers during round 22 of the NRL. Penrith sit atop the table.

programme.title: Live NRL: Broncos v Knights
programme.desc: The Brisbane Broncos enter round 22 of the NRL clinging onto slim hopes of the top eight as Reece Walsh and co take on a Newcastle team in the midst of a challenging period.

programme.title: Men's State of Origin Highlights
programme.desc: The 2026 men's State of Origin series reaches its finale with the third game between the Maroons and Blues. (08.07)

programme.title: My Icon: Kadeena Cox
